reference.role: User-confirmed strict primary B6 drawing and animation standard: Sample 1 portrait. Sample 2 V90 is secondary binding/engineering evidence, not a replacement style or limb-weight target.

segments.purpose: Primary character proportions, limb stroke and meme expression in the opening transaction
Spatial entry, staging, painted light and character/contact scale
Independent carriage travel and camera tracking through a broad painted world

style_standard.authority: User explicitly selected Sample 1 portrait as the favorite and strict acceptance standard on 2026-11-13
style_standard.limb_line_weight: Preserve Sample 1's visibly heavier single painted arm/leg stroke relative to the character. Compare similar views at matched head width; record the frames and normalization. Never inherit Sample 2 V90's finer wire-like limbs as the new-story default, invent a universal pixel width, or change body/camera scale to hide the difference.
style_standard.drawing: Match irregular pressure-varying ink, unified head/body brushwork, sparse asymmetric meme expressions and matte painted shapes. Keep stick limbs rather than flesh-filled anatomical forearms.
style_standard.light: Match soft painted light, readable value/midtone separation, localized restrained bloom, pale colored contact/underside shadows and matte material edges. Texture density follows visual hierarchy and remains local to artwork; a global warm/grain/blur filter does not establish the look.
style_standard.animation: Match its readable action/contact/release, emotional beats, broad layered space, motivated spatial camera work and rhythm. A valid skeleton or repeated flat zoom is insufficient.
style_standard.format: Portrait 9:16 works best. Landscape requires its own native composition and camera plan while preserving the primary drawing and performance standard; portrait preference does not change a user's requested ratio.
style_standard.secondary_reference: Hong Kong V90 supplies tested binding mechanics and an unchanged reproduction project. Its thinner lines and engineering pass do not supersede the primary style or approve a new performance.
style_standard.space_richness: Match the primary film’s broad usable world and changing spatial relationships: a move should expose meaningful new regions, depth-layer responses or foreground occlusion rather than repeatedly enlarging the same flat storefront. Demonstrate this in the representative segment; every individual shot need not travel or contain all layers.
style_standard.performance: Match the primary film’s readable, purposeful performance: preparation, decisive action or contact, release/recovery, supported body/shoulder/weight change, and timed gaze/emotion. Wrist-only gestures, slow inert posing and decorative torso sway do not establish that quality. A motivated still hold remains valid.
style_standard.captions: For portrait, use the exact English Sample 1 caption profile and actual decoded verification: Arial Black47/4 at720x1280, white/#171319, baseline914, band864..951, side44, 3xLanczos, immediate semantic phrase cuts. Preserved/synced is separate from matched. Landscape and explicit language/user deviations require their own documented native design/review.
style_standard.supporting_cast: All active identities/views and scene branches share the same drawing/binding constraints. Review sleeve exits, near/far arm ownership, purposeful occlusion, support/contact and gait/vehicle mechanics in actual encoded output, including background cast.

regressions: Sample 2 V90's thinner limbs must not replace Sample 1 portrait's relative stroke weight or painted brushwork.
A technically valid encode with same-storefront reframing and weak wrist-only acting must not be delivered as a completed B6 quality pass.
Known animation or spatial-richness failures must be repaired and re-reviewed; pending/needs_repair is not a completed local test unless the user explicitly requests an interim version.
Single-line, safe, synced or unchanged captions do not establish Sample 1 matching. At720x1280,42px/mm/y1100 differs from locked47px/ms/baseline914 and must fail the portrait profile.
A broad passed review category cannot cover missing detailed subchecks or a confirmed visible defect; review_correction cannot erase an actual known mismatch.
A reviewed still asset or successful skeleton trace does not certify every actor, expression, contact, native camera extreme or final encoded shot.
A global warm/grain/blur filter, constant character rocking or repeated flat zoom cannot replace painted value design, purposeful acting and broad layered-world camera work.

acceptance_contract.evaluation: Actual intended-speed moving preview and primary-reference comparison, supported by decoded neighboring frames and fingerprinted code. No cut-count, universal displacement threshold or synthetic similarity score supplies aesthetic acceptance.
acceptance_contract.failure_action: Continue authorized local dependency repair, animation/space correction, fresh encoding and review until the internal reference-aware standard passes. Preserve failed previews/reviews and link their unresolved findings into the next review pack.
acceptance_contract.completion_rule: Pending or needs_repair is active work, not a completed delivery or a reason to wait for user review. User-requested interim previews, explicit stops and evidenced external blockers remain valid boundaries; no paid/external action is newly authorized.
required_evidence: Closed prior-rejection repair log with current rendered and implementation evidence
All 35 detailed subchecks with actual candidate/reference observations
Locked portrait caption profile, renderer/font/source fingerprints and decoded text/transition evidence
Full cast/view/near-far limb coverage and contact/cut-neighbor inspection
Matched-scale drawing/light/material review separate from preserved hashes
acceptance_contract.required_subchecks: Every required_subchecks entry needs a separate verdict, actual observation, reviewed range, candidate/reference playback and fingerprinted implementation evidence. A broad pass cannot hide an omitted/failed subcheck.
acceptance_contract.mechanical_vs_perceptual: Profile/font/source/hash/coverage and evidence freshness checks are mechanical. They cannot certify perceived style, light, natural action, sync or storytelling; actual reference-aware moving/audio review remains mandatory.
acceptance_contract.preserved_vs_matched: Identical approved material proves reuse only; it does not prove primary-reference matching. Confirmed visible defects remain failures until rendered repair and re-observation.
acceptance_contract.review_scale: Review native-size encoded crops/frames and actual original-speed full-range AV. Low-resolution contact sheets locate issues but cannot supply final detail/motion/audio acceptance.

caption_profile_policy.portrait: Confirmed English Sample 1 renderer contract; scale geometry/type/stroke uniformly with portrait native resolution. Baseline is not the visible glyph center. No legacy bottom/mm layout, per-cue shrinking, pop, extra shadow or unintended blank flashing between continuous cues. Real speech pauses may have intentional cue gaps.
caption_profile_policy.landscape: The listed 16:9 coordinates are an unapproved local starting proposal, not observed V44 facts. Author a native_layout_reason and separately review native composition; size/baseline/band can be deliberately redesigned for this ratio. native_layout_reason is a scene-specific authored field; an empty template reason remains pending.
caption_profile_policy.language_or_explicit_override: When this font lacks required glyphs, or the user explicitly requests another subtitle design, record the language/user direction, exact intentional deviation and native review. Do not silently substitute a font/layout or claim an exact default-profile match.
caption_profile_policy.semantic_timing: Break from meaning and actual approved speech. V44 cue count/mean duration are observations, not quotas. Preserve complete phrases and original voice speed.

public_caption_profile_policy.authorization: Project owner explicitly approved Archivo Black as the redistributable public caption alternative on 2026-11-13.
public_caption_profile_policy.relation_to_primary: The original Sample 1 Arial Black caption profiles and hashes above remain unchanged. Archivo Black is a separately named implemented public alternative, not a claim of exact original font pixels. All other primary drawing, motion, space, speech timing and review requirements remain in force.
public_caption_profile_policy.font_license: SIL Open Font License 1.1; copied with the font into each new-story project.
public_caption_profile_policy.legacy_reproduction: The frozen Hong Kong V90 engine remains unchanged and provisions its original font aliases locally; this new-story font is outside engine/.
